# Anthony Zang

> Personal site of Anthony Zang — MS CS @ Georgia Tech, AI safety research.

## About

Anthony is a computer scientist and AI-safety researcher whose work centres on AI safety, interpretability, and observability. He earned his MS in Computer Science at the Georgia Institute of Technology (Aug 2025 – May 2026) and his BS in Computer Science there (Highest Honours). He is currently an AI Research Engineer (contract) at Redwood Research and an AI Researcher at Georgia Tech's Entertainment Intelligence & Human-Centered AI Lab (EI/HCAI Lab), and joins Applied Intuition as an engineer in August 2026. He previously interned on the backend & infrastructure team at Datadog, was a Technical Fellow with the AI Safety Initiative at Georgia Tech, and has served as a Lead Graduate TA for Algorithms (CS 3510) and Head TA for Discrete Mathematics (CS 2050).

## Projects

- [CouchMUN](https://zang.dev/projects/couchmun) — Open-source, locally run chairing platform for Model United Nations conferences. Deployed at conferences totaling 2,500+ participants.
- [ModeLLM](https://zang.dev/projects/modellm) — Analysis of LLM performances in simulated Model UN diplomacy contexts across 24 simulations with models from OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, and Meta.
- [Gitours](https://zang.dev/projects/gitours) — Proof-of-concept using LLMs for code and repository observability, analysis, and onboarding.
- [reModel](https://zang.dev/projects/remodel) — Room redesigner that takes an image of an existing room and redecorates it with real-life products using YOLOv8, SAM, and CLIP.
- [Personal Website](https://zang.dev/projects/personal-website) — Personal site built on a from-scratch, open-source template (Astro/TypeScript); a fun way to tinker with frontend.
- [WikiLeet](https://zang.dev/projects/wikileet) — GitHub Marketplace composite action to generate link-consistent wikis of a user's LeetCode solutions.
- [EHRudite](https://zang.dev/projects/ehrudite) — NLIDB platform for MIMIC-III clinical data, transforming English statements by medical professionals into precise MySQL queries via a pseudo-RAG pipeline.
